section_title: Prior art recheck and targeted finding sweeps
claim: A recheck on 2026-08-02 located nothing published on or after 1 August 2026 that occupies the ground: no population-scale conformance or provenance census of AI-derived or derived DICOM objects in a public archive, no quantified inter-validator disagreement study, and no population measurement of producer-attribution attributes.
status_note: This is a claim about our search, not about the literature. The recheck window is one day, from the 2026-08-01 sweep to the 2026-08-02 recheck, so the negative result is weak by construction and is reported as such. Its value is that it is dated, cheap and repeatable. Searched with LLM assistance, declared in results/ai_use.md.
value: arXiv all:DICOM most recent submission 2026-07-28; arXiv all:"Imaging Data Commons" most recent 2025-01-15; arXiv conformance AND medical AND imaging most recent 2026-07-09; PubMed edat from 2026/08/01: DICOM AND (conformance OR validation) 2 records neither relevant, "Imaging Data Commons" 0 records, DICOM AND provenance 0 records
denominator: 6 general web queries plus 3 arXiv API queries plus 3 PubMed E-utilities queries
dropped: One-day recheck window, so a publication appearing on 1 or 2 August 2026 and not yet indexed cannot be detected. Databases NOT searched: Google Scholar, Scopus, Web of Science, Embase, IEEE Xplore, Semantic Scholar, and the SPIE Medical Imaging, SIIM, EuroPACS, CARS and RSNA abstract archives. Non-English sources not searched. General web search was US-region with unknown recall.
notes: Two items predating the sweep were seen and are not occupying: arXiv:2508.01889v1, Medical Image De-Identification Resources, submitted 2025-08-03, which runs dciodvfy inside a de-identification benchmark on synthetic data; and arXiv:2607.25589v1, Forensic Reproducibility Audit of a Radiology Vision-Language Model Benchmark, submitted 2026-07-28. Both titles and dates verified through the arXiv API id_list endpoint.

section_title: Prior art recheck and targeted finding sweeps
claim: No prior description was located of Key Object Selection Document objects lacking General Equipment attributes, in IDC, in TCIA, or anywhere else. Finding (a) carries the only novelty claim of the three.
status_note: NOVEL, scoped. The claim is that no prior description was located by the search recorded in results/prior_art_recheck.md, never that nobody has observed this. Any manuscript wording must carry that scope.
value: 10 general web queries, 6 GitHub issue-search queries on the exact error strings returning 0 relevant hits, 3 IDC forum queries returning 1 unrelated topic, 3 PubMed queries returning 0 relevant records; 0 prior descriptions located
dropped: Databases and trackers NOT searched: Google Scholar, Scopus, Web of Science, Embase, IEEE Xplore, Semantic Scholar, and the SPIE, SIIM, EuroPACS, CARS and RSNA abstract archives. Issue tracker coverage is GitHub only: the DCMTK Redmine, the dcm4che Jira, the PixelMed issue list and SourceForge trackers including GDCM were reached only through general web search, not queried directly. The DICOM CP packs and WG-06 correspondence were not enumerated. comp.protocols.dicom was searched through Google Groups and general web search, not a complete archive dump. Non-English sources not searched.
notes: The measurement this literature claim attaches to is 40 of 40 KOS objects in IDC v24, flagged by dciodvfy as Error - Missing attribute Type 2 Required Element=<Manufacturer> Module=<GeneralEquipment> and by dicom-validator as Module <General Equipment> Tag (TAG) (Manufacturer) is missing. Two validators from different codebases agree, so this is not a candidate validator artefact, unlike findings (b) and (c).

section_title: Prior art recheck and targeted finding sweeps
claim: The General Equipment module is Mandatory in the Key Object Selection Document IOD and Manufacturer (0008,0070) is Type 2 within it, so an absent Manufacturer is not a permitted state and the requirement behind finding (a) is not in dispute.
status_note: Checked against the primary source, not measured here. This row exists so the novelty claim in G1-02 rests on a requirement a reviewer can confirm in one click rather than on our reading of a validator message.
value: PS3.3 Table A.35.4.3-1 lists General Equipment (C.7.5.1) with Usage M in the Key Object Selection Document IOD; Manufacturer (0008,0070) is Type 2 in the General Equipment module
dropped: Only the current published edition at dicom.nema.org was consulted, through a single retrieval of the A.35.4.3 chtml page. Earlier editions were not checked, so this row does not establish when the requirement was introduced. The pinned standard edition for this project is recorded in results/standards.json and was not re-derived here.

section_title: Prior art recheck and targeted finding sweeps
claim: The dciodvfy check that fires on Referenced Frame Number (0008,1160) present for a non-multi-frame Referenced SOP Class is already published, on a derived object, in the DICOM4QI connectathon results. Finding (b) is a prevalence measurement, not a discovery, and DICOM4QI must be cited where the finding is introduced.
status_note: KNOWN. Presenting finding (b) as novel would be falsified by one search. What we add is the population prevalence in Comprehensive SR, with a denominator, which DICOM4QI does not have.
value: DICOM4QI Siemens syngo.via segmentation results page reports, verbatim: Error - May not be present for Referenced SOP Class that is not multi-frame - attribute <ReferencedFrameNumber>
denominator: all DICOM4QI results pages enumerated from the site index and fetched individually: 4 SR TID1500 pages, 14 segmentation pages, the parametric map pages and the tractography pages
dropped: Three differences from our finding are unresolved and are reported rather than adjudicated: DICOM4QI reports it on a Segmentation object and we report it on Comprehensive SR; DICOM4QI records the wording May not be present where our census records Shall not be present, presumably a dciodvfy version difference we cannot resolve because the DICOM4QI dciodvfy version is not stated; and DICOM4QI is one hand-picked connectathon object with no sampling frame, no denominator and no rate. Databases NOT searched: see G1-05 dropped field.
command: curl -sL 'https://dicom4qi.readthedocs.io/en/latest/results/seg/syngovia/' and text extracted from raw HTML
notes: The page carries the attribution: DISCLAIMER: This section was completed by Andrey Fedorov using the version of software installed at Brigham and Women's Hospital. Representatives of Siemens were not involved in the presented evaluation. Quoted text verified against raw HTML, not a page summary. The string appears on that page and on no other DICOM4QI results page, in particular on none of the TID1500 SR pages.

section_title: Prior art recheck and targeted finding sweeps
claim: Finding (c), Laterality (0020,0060) reported as an Error by dciodvfy where the Type 2C condition cannot be evaluated, is documented by the validator's own author, both in the dciodvfy documentation and, against our exact error string, in a 2023 comp.protocols.dicom thread.
status_note: KNOWN, comprehensively. The manuscript must quote the author rather than characterise the behaviour in our own words, and must never present this as a discovery. It is the sharpest available illustration of why claim 2 is pitched as measurement rather than discovery, and it supplies the floor argument in the author's own words.
value: dciodvfy documentation: The presence or absence of the Laterality attribute when it is expected or not is reported as an error, not a warning, since it depends on the general mechanism of attribute condition checking used throughout. Same page, on limitations: Some of the reported errors and warnings may be spurious, particularly when conditions described in the DICOM standard depend on "real world" information that is not derivable from the DICOM Dataset itself. Mailing list, Simon Doran 2023-05-26 quotes verbatim: Error - Missing attribute Type 2C Conditional Element=<Laterality> Module=<GeneralSeries>
sop_class: Grayscale Softcopy Presentation State Storage; Real World Value Mapping Storage
denominator: 2 sources retrieved and read in full
dropped: Only the two primary sources named were retrieved. dclunie.blogspot.com was not enumerated post by post and was reached only through general web search. dicom3tools release notes and source comments were not read. Databases NOT searched: Google Scholar, Scopus, Web of Science, Embase, IEEE Xplore, Semantic Scholar, and the SPIE, SIIM, EuroPACS, CARS and RSNA abstract archives. comp.protocols.dicom was searched through Google Groups and general web search, not a complete archive dump. Non-English sources not searched.
command: curl -sL 'http://www.dclunie.com/dicom3tools/dciodvfy.html' ; curl -sL 'https://groups.google.com/g/comp.protocols.dicom/c/vDk2wnk-KaU' ; both with text extracted from raw HTML
notes: All quoted text was verified against raw HTML rather than a page summary, because both sources are load-bearing and one of the people quoted is a plausible reviewer. The first query issued for this finding returned the answer, which is itself worth recording: the cost of not checking would have been a novelty claim falsified by a single search.

section_title: Prior art recheck and targeted finding sweeps
claim: The dciodvfy author frames the Laterality behaviour as deliberate policy rather than as a defect. The words aggressive and spurious are both his, but spurious appears in the general limitations section and is not attached specifically to Laterality.
status_note: Recorded to stop the project putting the phrase false positive into the author's mouth. Our own rule forbids us adjudicating validator output either way, so the correct treatment is to quote the mechanism and the stated intent and let the reader classify it.
value: David Clunie, 28 May 2023: My dciodvfy tool is very aggressive about Laterality and Body Part Examined in order to encourage them to be populated correctly and consistently rather than be left empty or absent, using the Type 2(C) definition of required to have a value unless unknown as a reason to force the issue (begging the question of unknown to whom?)
sop_class: Grayscale Softcopy Presentation State Storage; Real World Value Mapping Storage
dropped: Same coverage limits as G1-07. In addition, no attempt was made to contact the author or to check whether his position has changed since 2023, and no later statement by him on this point was searched for beyond the general web queries recorded in results/prior_art_recheck.md.
notes: The objection a reviewer will raise is already in the thread, from Simon Doran on 28 May 2023: I agree with the desirability of what you are trying to do, but surely it's slightly unfair to be "aggressive" when a decision was obviously made somewhere along the line to make Body Part Examined a Type 3 element? The manuscript should not present that objection as its own.
